title: Boomkin Cleave vs Jungle
summary: The Feral is thinnest at four. But your own Boomkin and Shaman hold three each, and your AoE is what breaks your own CC.

sections.title: Kill the Feral, and keep the damage off the CC
sections.body: Counts, theirs: Hunter 6, Priest 5, Feral 4. Yours: Ret 8, Boomkin 3, Shaman 3. The Feral is the target. The real problem is your own comp: Boomkin and Ret both do splash damage, and every control you land on the Priest breaks to it. They will not be stacked, and assuming they are is what made the last version of this plan wrong.

sections.title: Opener — control the healer, then stop hitting him

steps.note: 30s. On the Priest. It repeats every go.
60s. Only lands if he is rooted — he walks out otherwise.
15s. The re-CC when the Beam is walked out of.

sections.title: The go — on the Feral, away from the Priest

steps.note: 120s. The slowest term; this is the cadence.
60s. Half-cadence, so it aligns every second go.
30s. Filler, and it is the splash that breaks CC.
45s. Point it at the Feral, not between the two.
36s. Up every go; not worth forcing.
25s, and your Boomkin holds three answers.
30s. Breaks your channel, not just your position.
